iteration.source: (Array.isArray(_local.form?.language_currency?.currencies) ? _local.form.language_currency.currencies : []).map((c, i) => ({...c, _idx: i})).sort((a, b) => { const defaultCurrency = _local.form?.language_currency?.default_currency; if (a.code === defaultCurrency) return -1; if (b.code === defaultCurrency) return 1; return 0; })
